reason: The README describes a note- and PDF-to-knowledge-base plugin that classifies content, creates Yuque directories and documents, and uploads referenced images to GitHub.

summaries.zh: 将文本、图片和 PDF 内容整理分类，并保存为带图片的 Markdown 笔记到语雀知识库。
summaries.en: Organizes text, images, and PDF content into categorized Markdown notes and saves them to a Yuque knowledge base.

capabilities: Reads local note and PDF files
Creates directories and Markdown documents in a Yuque knowledge base
Uploads referenced images to a configured GitHub repository
Calls Yuque and GitHub APIs using configured credentials
